top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs the one shortlisted achievement that gave chemistry a new concept of molecular organisation (liquid-liquid phase separation organising cells into membraneless compartments, Hyman and Brangwynne, founded on the reproducible 2009 P-granule work) with Liu's base editing, a cleanly attributed, independently replicated chemical tool (programmed base deamination plus deaminase evolution, distinct from the cleavage-based 2020 prize). Liu-only for B011 is the attribution I can defend; the cost is that Rosen, Pappu and Mittag are omitted and condensate maturity is debated. If P004 fails, I prefer Liu alone (P002) and then the Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli degrader prize (P001) over the nitrogenase combinations; any award beats none.
recusal_note: No personal or institutional tie to any credited candidate; my lipid self-assembly and lipid-protein co-assembly research is scientifically close to phase separation (B065), a proximity I do not judge to require recusal.
